notes.title: Shakedown: Hawaii Update v1.1.6
notes.content:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]
[h2]v1.1.6 - November 18th, 2024[/h2]

The CEO's order of office supplies has just arrived... which means he's got a few new toys to play with! His idea of a [i]"letter opener"[/i] might be a bit much, although his research lab's brand new lightgun makes that look downright medieval.
 
That's right! A new update for [i]Shakedown: Hawaii[/i] is now available. The [i]"Pen vs. Sword"[/i] update adds new weapons, challenges, styles, a multiplier assistant feature, and more.

Here's a quick rundown...

[list]
[*][b]New Weapons[/b][/*][list][*]Sword & Shield[/*][*]Pen[/*][*]Lightgun![/*][/list]
[*][b]New Arcade Challenges[/b][/*][list][*]A challenge for each new weapon.[/*][/list]
[*][b]Adds a Multiplier Assistant[/b][/*][list][*]You can now max out your revenue with a single click.[/*][/list]
[*][b]Adds Masks to the Costume Shop[/b][/*][list][*]You can now choose a new mask for your disguise.[/*][/list]
[*][b]DirectX Renderer[/b][/*][list][*]Fixed re-initialization errors that could occur when switching modes.[/*][/list]
[*][b]Button Icons[/b][/*][list][*]Although the game auto-detects most popular game controllers, you can now manually choose a specific button icon style (PlayStation or Xbox style icons) from the menu.[/*][/list]
[*][b]More Controller Support[/b][/*][list][*]Additional PlayStation controllers are now automatically detected and no longer need to be calibrated.[/*][/list]
[*][b]Leaderboards[/b][/*][list][*]If leaderboards appear to be unavailable (ie. if you're offline), the game will no longer continuously attempt to read them. This should improve performance when playing offline.[/*][/list]
[*][b]Extra Hints[/b][/*][list][*]A hint to switch characters will now appear if a different one is needed to progress. This addresses an issue where some missions or properties may not unlock until you switch back to another character.[/*][/list]
[*][b]Misc. Bug Fixes[/b][/*][/list]

[h2]MORE DETAILS[/h2]

[h3]The New Weapons[/h3]

[b]The Sword and Shield![/b] In addition to looking rad, harnessing even more melee strength, and adding a new way to landscape, you'll take 50% less damage when the sword and shield is active. Selecting it when low on health could mean the difference between winning the battle and having to restart from the last checkpoint. Watch out though! You're not the only one with this equipment -- one of the shakedowns now puts you toe to toe with a sword-wielding shopkeeper.
 
[b]A Pen?![/b] Is the pen really mightier than the sword? Well... in this game, pens can be used at far range to repeatedly knock enemies down and send them bouncing off screen. 
 
[b]The Lightgun!![/b] This might just be the most combo-centric weapon in the game. A single blast can defeat an entire cluster of nearby enemies or completely destroy a vehicle. Stay back though... you'll be electrocuted too if you don't keep your distance. It also sets objects on fire, so watch where you step when mashing that button. 
 
 Each added weapon introduces a new way to interact with the world. Item pickups can be found scattered across the city, waiting to be collected. The pen and sword are both available right away, but your research lab  won't have the resources to build the lightgun until you've upgraded the facility with every multiplier. Once you have, the lightgun can be found inside both the research lab and the CEO's house.
 
[h3]The Multiplier Assistant[/h3]
 
Speed up property upgrades and max out your revenue with a single click! When turned on, the [i]Multiplier Assistant[/i] option will automatically spend your daily earnings on multipliers.
 
Found under the Business menu, this option is unlocked once you've acquired every building in the city. 
 
[h3]More Costume Options[/h3]
 
In addition to your hat, wig, beard, and glasses, you can now choose a new mask for your disguise. Find the new item rack inside the costume shops.
 
[h3]Extra Hints[/h3]
 
There are a few occasions in the game when you need to be a certain character for some missions or properties to unlock. The story mode automatically switches you to the correct character for this to happen. However, if you manually change your character at certain points in the game, you may not see new missions or properties appear that are required to progress further. When this happens, the game will now display occasional reminders to switch back.
 
[h3]Engine Updates[/h3]
 
The DirectX renderer has been updated to fix re-initialization errors that could occur when switching modes [i](such as between Windowed and Full Screen, or resolution changes)[/i].
 
Additional PS4 and PS5 controllers are now automatically detected and no longer need to be calibrated. Some editions of these controllers show up with different GUIDs on Windows, so it now maps those as well. Although the game auto-detects most popular game controllers, you can now also manually choose a specific button icon style [i](PlayStation or Xbox style icons)[/i] from the menu.
 
Arrow keys can now always be used to navigate the menu, even if the in-game movement's been switched to WASD-only mode. 
 
This update includes a few Steam-specific improvements. Most importantly, if leaderboards appear to be unavailable [i](ie. if you're offline)[/i], the game will no longer continuously attempt to read them. This should improve performance when playing offline.


Thank you so much for playing! I hope you enjoy the new update.
-Brian, Developer of Shakedown: Hawaii

notes.title: Shakedown: Hawaii Update v1.1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]
[h3]v1.1.2 (PC) - October 31, 2020[/h3]

The new v1.1.2 update is now live!

[list]
[*]Added PS5 DualSense controller support.

[*]PS4 controllers can now use R2 as an alternate fire button.

[*]Added new polished pixel art for the circuit board shakedown minigame.

[*]The "daily revenue" icon now shows both corporate and protection revenue, not just corporate.

[*]Enemy AI improved in the "Catch a Break" shakedown mission.

[*]Enemies in missions "Ceramic Parable" and "Clean Sweep" now attack more aggressively if the player tries to use a vehicle to take them down (when playing under normal difficulty).

[*]Fixed a shakedown bug which caused some missions to be stuck in a "Mission Failed" loop.

[*]Adjusted the car export garage's max cars per week to 5.

[*]Fixed some visual glitches in 1X zoom mode.

[*]Fixed a map zoom bug.

[*]Misc. optimizations for low end PCs.

[*]Misc. minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]


Thanks so much for playing! I hope these improvements make the game even better for you. If you discover any game bugs or issues, don't hesitate to email support.

For more information on the previous updates, check out [url=https://www.vblank.com/20201015_sh_steam.php]this post (v1.1.0)[/url] and [url=https://www.vblank.com/20201024_update.php]this post (v1.1.1)[/url].

notes.title: Shakedown: Hawaii Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Shakedown: Hawaii Update Notes[/h1]
[h3]v1.1.1 (PC) - October 24, 2020[/h3]

[list]
[*]Gloves have been added to various shops, so you can now[i] "customize"[/i] your character's hands. Check out the mall [i](second floor) [/i]or large department store on the west side of the map[i] (among other places)[/i] to grab some.

[*]During the "Territory Takeover" shakedown missions, enemies will now more fiercely counter vehicle attacks[i] (level 3 onward)[/i]. This encourages players to engage in combat and use a more strategic approach.

[*]The "Live Broadcast" boss AI has been improved and made slightly more challenging[i] (particularly under normal difficulty)[/i]. Tweaks were also made to improve the experience under 3X zoomed-in mode.

[*]The "Lost Locks" shakedown now lets you clear the security guards by cutting their hair too. This provides players with an alternative approach to get rid of them.

[*]Tuned "Ballistic Pick Pocket" Arcade Challenge.

[*]Chase missions now better handle players entering vehicles.

[*]Adjusted "Live Stream" mission minigame to clarify keyboard controls.

[*]Vehicle spawning improvements.

[*]Misc. bug fixes.
[/list]

Thanks so much for playing! I hope these improvements make the game even better for you. If you discover any game bugs or issues, don't hesitate to email support.

For more information on the previous update (v1.1.0), check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/598730/view/5342917415224274351]this post[/url].
